topics.title: EU–Armenia cooperation deepening
topics.text: Romanian Foreign Minister expressed readiness to deepen the EU–Armenia agenda following congratulations from Armenian Minister Mirzoyan. The exchange signals continued diplomatic engagement between Yerevan and Brussels.

sources.title: Ready to further deepen ambitious EU–Armenia cooperation agenda, Romanian Foreign Minister says in response to Mirzoyan’s congratulations

topics.title: Border breach allegations
topics.text: Yerevan neither confirmed nor denied a second border incident this month, as reported by Armenian sources. The development follows earlier reports of border breaches between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

sources.title: Yerevan Neither Confirms Nor Denies a Second Border Breach this Month

topics.title: Armenian exports to EU
topics.text: Armenian exports to EU member states rose by 51% according to data from Papoyan and the economy minister. The growth reflects expanding trade ties between Yerevan and Brussels.

sources.title: Armenian exports to EU member states rise by 51%, says Papoyan

topics.title: Mirzoyan on CSTO and EAEU
topics.text: The Armenian FM stated he is unaware of a legal mechanism to expel Armenia from the EAEU, while also saying he does not see Armenia returning to the CSTO. Sovereignty and independence were cited as top priorities.

sources.title: Mirzoyan unaware of legal mechanism to expel Armenia from EAEU or suspend its membership

topics.title: TRIPP agreement and US cooperation
topics.text: The TRIPP agreement marks an unprecedented level of Armenia–US economic cooperation, according to Mirzoyan. The FM also noted that prohibited goods including weapons cannot transit under the mechanism.

sources.title: TRIPP Agreement marks unprecedented level of Armenia-US economic cooperation – Mirzoyan

topics.text: The International Nature Prescribing Alliance was launched at COP17 in Yerevan. Discussions also covered green standards for sports centres and common nature assessment standards for businesses.
